name: DataMap
summary: Paste a column of numbers, get a choropleth

shot.alt: DataMap showing a choropleth of 2025 GDP by US state

hook: Paste a column of numbers, get a choropleth whose color scale you can defend in a code review.
built: OKLCH ramps, quantile breaks, runs offline, Playwright tests

notes: Diverging scales default to symmetric quantile breaks; equal-interval was tried first and collapsed real county data into a single neutral class.
Ships with a rebuild pipeline that re-fetches World Bank, Census, and ISO-3166 sources and regenerates every dataset.
pages.caption: Seven-class ramps exactly as DataMap’s color.js builds them. Every hue reuses one lightness track, so each column shares an L value.

blurb: paste data, get a choropleth map
